artworks.title: Title Page to Arcana Clericalia or the Misteries of Clerkshipp by George Billinghurst
artworks.description: The image shows a courtroom or a formal assembly with multiple figures. Two prominent areas feature individuals dressed in period attire. In the upper section, four seated figures wearing robes and caps hold scrolls. Their faces are partially visible, showcasing serious expressions. In the area behind them, a decorative wall hanging or tapestry with elaborate patterns surrounds the scene. The lower section features a table with documents and an inkpot, attended by three figures engaged in discussions. Numerous standing figures surround the main scene, organized in rows on the left, right, and behind the seated figures, all depicted from the waist up, wearing long robes and caps. The background is intricate, filled with woodcut or engraved detailing, conveying the setting of a solemn gathering.

artworks.title: Title Page to The New World of Words or A General English Dictionary
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a dictionary title page. The drawing features portraits down each side with names underneath each one. The center showcases a globe design inscribed with "Novus Orbis" and "Verborum", encapsulated by pillars with a banner. The middle section contains text introducing "The new World of Words or a Generall English Dictionary," followed by a description of its contents. Above this, the artwork divides into two upper sections illustrating the cityscapes of "Cambridge" and "Oxford".

artworks.title: Title Page to the Moderne World of Words, or A Universal English Dictionary
artworks.description: The image is an ornate illustration featuring a collection of portrait engravings bordered by architectural elements. At the top are detailed cityscapes labeled "Cambridge" and "Oxford." The central area contains a decorative banner with the text "The Moderne World of Words," dated 1696. Portraits of historical figures such as "Spenser," "Lambard," "Selden," "Chaucer," "Camden," "Spelman," "S.P. Sidney," "A Scholer of Cambridge," "F. Bacon," and "A Scholer of Oxford" are framed within rectangular borders topped with classic columns. Each figure is depicted in historical attire. The text attributes the work to R. Bentley, F. Phillips, H. Rhodes, and J. Taylor. At the bottom, there's an illustration of a globe labeled "Novus Orbis Verborum." The composition is symmetrical, with the globe centralizing the design amid the portraits, all set against a parchment-like textured backdrop.

artworks.title: Title Page to Hermes Theologus or New Descants Upon Old Records, Theoph. Woodnote
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure identified as Hermes surrounded by various theological representations and figures. The central image portrays a figure with wings, holding a caduceus in one hand, and a rod in the other. This figure is encased within a decorative oval frame flanked by two open books labeled as the New Testament and the Old Testament. Above this, a Hebrew name, YHWH, is inscribed. The lower half of the image is segmented into four thematic quadrants, each depicted with a different character. The entire piece is titled "HERMES THEOLOGUS or New Descants upon OLD RECORDS." The bottom of the drawing seems to feature an inscription or signature.

artworks.title: Title Page to Hermes Theologus or New Descants Upon Old Records, Theoph. Woodnote
artworks.description: This image features an allegorical scene with religious and mythological symbolism. In the central panel, Hermes, the Greek messenger god, is depicted holding a staff with entwined snakes, surrounded by clouds. Above him are inscriptions and an illustration of a hand pointing to books labeled "The Testa New ment" and "The Testa Old ment." Surrounding Hermes are four smaller panels labeled as The Christian, The Jew, The Turke, and The Pagan, each paired with scriptural references and depictions of individuals in traditional or symbolic attire. The composition conveys a discourse on religious themes and ideologies, with detailed engravings and text typical of scholarly or philosophical works from the Renaissance or early modern period.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman in an Oval with Coat of Arms
artworks.description: The image shows a woman from the chest up, facing forward. She has a rounded face, small mouth, and large eyes, with hair styled back. She wears an ornate dress with a wide lace collar, layered textures, a brooch, and earrings. The background is plain with an oval frame featuring decorative scrolls and a coat of arms at the bottom. The style is reminiscent of an engraving or etching, giving the portrait a historical appearance.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.description: The image is an engraving featuring a man from the chest up. He is facing forward, with distinctive facial features including a mustache, goatee, and a cap partially covering his hair. He is wearing formal clothing with lace detailing on the collar. There are no visible accessories or objects. The background consists of horizontal lines. Above the portrait, there are two coat of arms, adding a heraldic element. Below the portrait, there is Latin text, the year 1652, and the man's age at 66.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Geographer
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man framed from the waist up. He is depicted seated, facing slightly towards the left. The man has high cheekbones, a long nose, a straight mouth, deep-set eyes, and long, wavy hair reaching his shoulders, parted in the middle. He is wearing a dark garment with a white collar and holding a pen in his right hand above an open book on the table in front of him. Next to the book is a globe, and there is an architectural element in the background. In the top right corner, a figure of a mythological creature, possibly a satyr, is present. The text below the image appears to be a poem related to wisdom or intellectual pursuit.

artworks.title: Portrait of an Astronomer
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man's bust within an oval frame. The man is facing slightly to his right with a serious expression. He has wavy hair, a prominent nose, and full lips. He is wearing a high-collared dark garment with a white cravat. The oval frame features a circular zodiac chart with astrological symbols and numbers, embellished with scrollwork at the top and bottom. The background is plain with a textured surface.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man with a Broad Collar
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man. The man is shown from the upper half of his body, slightly turned to the left but looking directly at the viewer. He has medium-length curly hair, a mustache, and a goatee. He is wearing a dark textured garment with a high lace collar typical of 17th-century fashion. His right hand is visible and holding the edge of his garment near his chest. The background consists of finely hatched lines forming an oval frame around him, emphasizing the classical portrait style of the engraving.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man With a Ruff
artworks.description: The image shows a man with a beard and mustache, wearing an ornate, high-collared garment. He is portrayed looking directly at the viewer, with curly hair styled neatly on his head. The background is plain, highlighting the man and his attire.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body portrait of a person facing the viewer, with their head slightly turned to the right. They have delicate facial features, symmetrical eyebrows, large eyes, and a subtle smile. The individual has curly hair framing their face. They are wearing an elaborate garment with intricate patterns and a large lace ruff around the neck. A gemstone or medallion is displayed at the chest, possibly attached to a chain or clothing. The background is plain, with an oval frame surrounding the portrait, giving it an antique look.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man in Toga
artworks.description: The image features a man in a bust portrait. He faces slightly to his right with a direct gaze forward. The man has sharp facial features with a prominent nose, defined cheekbones, and a well-groomed mustache and beard. He has short hair and is wearing a draped garment resembling a toga. The background is plain and lightly speckled. The illustration is enclosed within an oval frame on aged beige paper.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Clergyman
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up. He is facing forward with his hands resting on a surface in front of him, one holding a small open book or piece of paper with writing on it. The man's facial features include deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, and a long, full beard with a mustache. He has short hair that is slightly tousled. He is wearing a long, dark robe over a lighter-colored garment with a high collar that is intricately ruffled. The robe features a textured pattern with multiple buttons running down the front. There are no visible pieces of jewelry. The background is a simple, unadorned pattern of lines and shading, with a phrase inscribed at the upper left corner.

artworks.title: Abbas I, Shah of Persia
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting on a rearing horse. He is holding the reins in one hand and a sword in the other. The man has distinct facial features, including a large nose and a styled beard. He wears a turban, a robe with a sash, and tight-fitting trousers. The saddle is detailed, and the background is a simple landscape with sparse vegetation. The text "THE KING OF PERSIA" is displayed above the image.

artworks.title: Nicholas Ridley, D.D., Bishop of London, Martyr
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man from the chest up. He is facing forward, with a long beard and solemn expression. His hair is neatly combed back, displaying a receding hairline. He wears historical clothing, most likely from the 16th century. The background is simple, with the man framed within an oval line. Text below the portrait identifies him as "Nichol: Ridley," with additional text providing information about his life and death in the year 1555.

artworks.title: Title Page to the Compleat Horseman
artworks.description: This is an image of ornate equestrian artwork and architecture. The drawing features a grand architectural facade with a sign that reads "The Compleat Horseman Part the 1st." Atop the structure stands a detailed horse, while below are two figures with their own horses. A central archway reveals an interior scene with multiple horses and riders. The artwork showcases intricate linework, shading, and attention to detail in the horses' musculature and architectural designs. The overall composition conveys a sense of elegance and admiration for horsemanship.

artworks.title: Queen Mary I of England
artworks.description: The engraving depicts the upper body of a regal figure in profile facing left. The figure has a prominent nose and chin, adorned with an elaborate headdress that includes pearls and possibly a veil. The clothing is decorated with floral patterns and there is a visible brooch. The portrait is encased in an oval frame with inscriptions. In the background, there are ornate elements with a ram's head at the top, floral motifs, and mythical creatures at the lower corners.

artworks.title: James IV of Scotland, Margaret, Daughter of Henry VII, Archibald Douglas, Earl of Angus, Henry VII, Elizabeth of York
artworks.description: The image is a black-and-white illustration showing four historical figures in oval frames, each depicted from the shoulders up with different positions and facial features. The top left oval contains a person labeled "King James IV," showing a man with long hair wearing a hat, with a serious expression. The top center oval features "Princess Margaret," a woman with an ornate headdress. The top right oval contains "Archibald Douglas," a man with a distinctive hat and a long face. The bottom left depicts a man labeled "Henry VII," wearing a flat hat and fur-trimmed clothing, with a medallion on his chest. The bottom right showcases "Elizabeth York," who is wearing an intricate headdress and a patterned garment. The background is filled with intricate coat-of-arms and floral designs, connecting the ovals with illustrative branches that form a harmonious and symmetrical composition. The emblems and illustrative elements suggest a royal or noble context, highlighted by the decorative crowns and shields.

artworks.title: Queen Mary I
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing upright with both hands in front of her body, holding a small book or booklet. Her facial features include high, arched eyebrows, a small nose, and thin lips. Her hair is styled with an ornate crown, and she wears an elegant gown with intricate detailing, a high collar, belt, and a bracelet. The background has a textured surface with a border, a Latin inscription, and an illustration of a mask-like figure with a beard or lion's face.

artworks.title: Queen Elizabeth
artworks.description: The image is a portrait engraving of a person seen from the head and shoulders, slightly turned to the right and looking directly at the viewer. The facial features include a high forehead, arched eyebrows, prominent eyes, a straight nose, and small closed lips. The curly hair is styled away from the face. The person is wearing an elaborate lace ruff around the neck with pearls, a dark garment with buttons and pearls, and a brooch or decorative detail on the shoulder. The background is plain, highlighting the oval frame or medallion around the portrait with inscribed text along the rim.

artworks.title: Mary, Queen of Scots
artworks.description: This image depicts an engraved portrait of a seated person from the chest up. The individual is facing slightly to the viewer's right, wearing a large ruffled collar that extends around the shoulders and neck. The person has a sharp nose, thin lips, and delicate eyebrows. Their hair is styled back and appears smooth and close to the head. The clothing is richly detailed with intricate patterns on the sleeves and a fitted bodice. There is a pendant around the neck. The image is surrounded by a circular frame with an inscription naming the individual as "Maria Stvard." Two crests are located at the top corners, one with fleur-de-lis and the other with a heraldic lion rampant. The background within the circle has fine lines, while the corners outside the circle show small scenes with multiple figures engaged in various activities.

artworks.title: Mary, Queen of Scots
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a person with an oval face, prominent forehead, closed lips, and hair styled in tight curls. The individual faces slightly to the right and looks directly at the viewer. They wear a pleated ruff around their neck and textured clothing. There is no visible jewelry. The background features an oval border with French inscriptions and a lined texture.

artworks.title: James, King of Scots
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing sideways with legs slightly apart, gazing directly at the viewer. He has a calm expression and distinctive facial features, including a pointed chin and a straight nose. He wears a large hat with a flat brim, obscuring his hair. His clothing is ornate, consisting of a tunic with puffed sleeves, secured at the waist by a belt, and emblazoned with a large medallion or jewel. He holds a sword. Beside him stands a stag with large antlers, resting a crowned shield at its feet adorned with a heraldic lion and fleur-de-lis patterns. The background features an elaborate curtain and a seascape visible through an archway, including a rocky cliff with a castle and sailing ships on the water.
